headline: Fixed empty specialized bag slot glyphs blending into the Papercraft theme.

entries.title: Specialized bag slot glyphs missing on Papercraft theme
entries.details: Empty slots in specialized bags, such as reagent bags, quivers, and profession bags, drew a white glyph that blended into the light Papercraft theme background and looked missing. In Papercraft, these glyphs now use the theme's ink color so they are visible.
